proposal.summary: Proposed Phase 4 architecture tasks only; nothing registered or executed. Supplied context contains no actual diff or independent check records, so it cannot establish implementation completion. Referenced plans and Phase 3 behavior remain unverified. No human approval is inferred.

tasks.title: Establish Phase 4 requirements and baseline
tasks.description: Reconcile the implementation plan, Phase 3 results, execution documentation, current source changes and trusted decision receipts. Record requirement-to-evidence mappings and unresolved gates before implementing dependent behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Each Phase 4 requirement maps to a bounded implementation task and an independent verification method.
Existing modifications are inventoried against the Phase 3 source commit without overwriting unrelated work.
Missing approval receipts remain explicit pending gates; comments and historical review claims confer no authorization.
Cadenda context and diagnostic results are recorded through Recorder with artifact hashes under state/.

tasks.title: Define strict architect and reviewer contracts
tasks.description: Implement versioned JSON schemas and semantic validators for task proposals and review findings. Keep proposals separate from Beads registration and human decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Schemas reject unknown fields, invalid enum values, missing required fields and oversized outputs.
Proposal validation rejects duplicate identifiers, unknown dependencies, dependency cycles and tasks outside the permitted scope.
Review results distinguish approved from changes_requested and bind findings to requirements and reviewed evidence.
Independent negative tests cover malformed JSON, schema violations and source text attempting to grant approval.

tasks.title: Implement bounded Codex adapters
tasks.description: Add architect and separate reviewer adapters using verified local CLI capabilities, argument arrays, explicit timeouts and bounded output capture.
acceptance_criteria: Recorded CLI version and help establish supported invocation and structured-output options.
Successful process exit alone cannot yield a valid proposal or review; schema validation, stderr classification and artifact integrity are checked.
Denial, timeout, cancellation, truncated output and invalid responses produce explicit non-success states.
Adapters cannot grant human approval, mutate Issues or invoke an automatic alternate cloud provider; PCC remains disabled.

tasks.title: Add persistent routing and approval gates
tasks.description: Implement explicit transitions from validated proposal through trusted approval, isolated implementation, deterministic checks and separate review, using SQLite as Run authority and Beads as Issue authority.
acceptance_criteria: Unapproved proposals cannot start implementation or automatically register tasks.
Approval binds to a canonical action hash covering the proposal, scope, baseline and execution policy; material changes invalidate it.
Reviewer inputs contain requirements, the actual diff and recorded independent checks; implementer summaries are supplementary only.
Review decisions bind to exact source and evidence hashes; subsequent changes invalidate the decision.
Restart preserves pending gates without replaying implementation or fabricating approval, and no transition automatically closes an Issue.

tasks.title: Implement bounded correction and escalation
tasks.description: Route actionable review findings into a persisted, limited correction loop that reruns affected checks and obtains a fresh separate review.
acceptance_criteria: Correction attempts and total execution time have finite configured limits persisted across restarts.
Each correction remains within approved scope; scope expansion requires a new trusted decision.
Denial, invalid output, exhausted limits or unresolved findings stop dependent execution and record a human escalation.
A prior approved review cannot authorize a changed diff, and changes_requested cannot satisfy the completion gate.

tasks.title: Verify the complete flow and publish handoff
tasks.description: Exercise the pipeline on a scoped fixture repository with isolated implementation worktrees, Recorder artifacts and Outbox delivery. Update compatibility, risks and Phase 4 handoff documents using independently recorded results.
acceptance_criteria: A recorded fixture flow demonstrates approved decomposition, isolated implementation, deterministic checks and separate review.
Independent tests demonstrate safe stops for forged comment approval, stale hashes, malformed and denied outputs, failed checks, retry exhaustion and restart.
Completion is blocked whenever required evidence or trusted human approval is missing, even if all subprocesses exit successfully.
Recorder retains Run authority, Beads retains Issue authority and Outbox retries do not duplicate mutations.
Documentation distinguishes measured results from assumptions and lists unresolved gates with exact resumption steps; no production deployment or Issue closure occurs.
